description: This file contains unit tests for the UserRoleManagerService class within the OrangeHRM system. It tests the functionality related to retrieving and validating user role manager classes, including handling valid, invalid, non-existing classes, and cases where no logged-in user exists.

classes.name: InvalidUserRoleManager
classes.description: A dummy class that does not extend the required AbstractUserRoleManager for testing invalid class handling.

classes.name: UnitTestUserRoleManager
classes.description: A mock subclass of AbstractUserRoleManager used for testing valid manager retrieval and behavior.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initial setup for each test, creating the kernel environment.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerClassName
methods.description: Tests retrieving the class name of the user role manager based on configuration.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerExistingClass
methods.description: Tests the creation and retrieval of a user role manager when a valid class is specified and exists.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerInvalidClass
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown if the configured user role manager class does not extend the required base class.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerNonExistingClass
methods.description: Checks behavior when the configured class name does not correspond to an existing class.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerNoLoggedInUser
methods.description: Verifies that an exception is thrown when no user is logged in.
